equipment_type: Air-cooled variable-speed screw chiller (via E-Link gateway)
applies_to: YORK YVAA, YVFA (free cooling) and YAGK air-cooled variable-speed screw chillers with 031-02478 or 031-03478 microboards, connected through a YORK E-Link gateway over YorkTalk 2.
summary: Before the SC-EQ card, YORK by Johnson Controls YVAA-family chillers reached a BAS through the E-Link gateway, which reads the microboard over YorkTalk 2 (4800 baud) and serves BACnet, N2, LON and Modbus objects. Objects are named by YorkTalk page (YT2_S01_P03 and so on). Section 1 holds the remote commands and core chiller data; section 2 (instances from 101) holds free cooling, Aggreko, power and option points that depend on the microboard program.
notes: Object names are the E-Link's YorkTalk page names, not plain-language names; the descriptions say what each one is.
Access follows the sheet's Modbus function note: the first eight objects (AV 1-4, BV 1-4) accept writes; the rest are read-only.

The sheet lists ten chiller program versions with a Standard/Optional/Not available code per point; points marked not available on every version are left out, and many section-2 points only exist on newer programs or with options.

Multistate states are shown as printed (code tables and most enums from 0); the sheet says nothing about adding 1. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; confirm by discovery (read the state text).
The sheet lists BACnet objects but does not name the BACnet transport (MS/TP or IP); check the E-Link setup. The SC-EQ card replaces the E-Link (see the YVAA Style B SC-EQ list).
Units shown are imperial; SI units are in the sheet.

source.title: YVAA, YVFA, YAGK York Talk 2 (E-Link) points list, boards 031-02478 / 031-03478

integration.summary: Put the chiller in remote control (BV 20 reads Remote), then start/stop it with BV 1 and write the remote setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2) through the E-Link. Read BV 5 for chiller run, the leaving chilled liquid temperature and VSD frequency, and BV 6 for the chiller alarm.

minimum_points.name: YT2_S01_P51
minimum_points.why: Must read Remote (1) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 20 shows Local or Remote control mode. The sheet gives no point to change it and no write-enable point.
integration.heartbeat: Operational code 67 is 'Loss of External Communications'; the sheet gives no timeout or heartbeat point.
setup: The E-Link talks to the chiller microboard over YorkTalk 2 at 4800 baud for every program version listed.
LON needs the LON version of the E-Link (SNVT_count_f and SNVT_switch only).
gotchas: BV 4 switches the data between live values and history buffer 1; leave it at 0 for live data.
The E-Link publishes every possible chiller point, even ones that don't apply to the unit (per the SC-EQ install guide).
Replacing an E-Link with an SC-EQ changes the object names; the SC-EQ guide says to delete the E-Link device and re-discover.
